title: Fast Descent - Autumn's Last Solar Term
prompt: Describe the significance of Fast Descent in autumn.
hint: Mention the date, natural changes, and cultural practices.
sample: Fast Descent occurs around October 23rd and marks the last solar term of autumn. The ground sparkles with frost, maple leaves turn brilliant red, and people eat sweet persimmons.

ja.prompt: 秋の「霜降」の意味を説明してください。
ja.hint: 日付、自然の変化、文化的な習慣について述べてください。
ja.sample: 霜降は10月23日頃で、秋の最後の節気です。地面に霜が降り、カエデの葉が鮮やかな赤色になり、人々は甘い柿を食べます。

title: Observing Nature During Fast Descent
prompt: List three natural phenomena observed during Fast Descent.
hint: Think about frost, leaf color, and morning scenery.
sample: During Fast Descent, the ground sparkles with white frost in the morning, maple leaves turn bright red, and the air feels cooler as autumn ends.

title: Cultural Traditions of Fast Descent
